name: Username
phraseWarning: Write these 24 words down on paper, in order, and keep them safe. They are the only way to recover your account. Never share them.
phraseConfirm: I have written down my recovery phrase
noContacts: No contacts yet. Share your code or add a friend's code.
selectContact: Select a contact to start chatting.
inviteHint: Send this code to a friend, or let them scan the QR code. It contains no secret.
safetyHint: Compare this number with your contact (in person or by call). If it matches, nobody is intercepting your messages.
readReceiptsHint: Your contacts see when you have read their messages.
emailHint: Lets you recover your account if you lose your device. Never shown to others.
discoverable: Let people find me by username
discoverableHint: Exact username only. Your IP address is never shared.
codeSent: If this account has a verified email, a code has been sent.
newPhraseInfo: Your account has new keys. Your contacts will be told that your safety number changed.
registryOff: No account server: username search and recovery are unavailable.
err_user_not_found: No user with this username (or they are not searchable).
err_name_mismatch: This recovery phrase belongs to another username.
backupHint: Contacts and history, encrypted with your password before leaving this device. The server cannot read it. If you forget the password, the backup is lost.
backupOn: Enabled: automatic backup every 30 minutes when something changes.
restoreHint: If you enabled encrypted backups, enter your backup password to get your contacts and history back.
keyChangedBanner: The safety number of {name} changed (account recovered or reinstalled). Compare it again before sharing anything sensitive.
nameUnconfirmedBanner: This username was announced by the contact but is not confirmed by the account server.
deleteAccount: Delete my account from the server
deleteConfirm: Click again to confirm: username, email and backup will be erased.
err_no_backup: No backup found for this account.
